headline: Start Investing With Just ₹500 Monthly
body: Beginning early with small amounts helps build wealth gradually. Consistency matters more than the investment size itself.
caption: Young investors benefit from starting early, even with modest amounts. Time and discipline are powerful wealth-building tools. #InvestEarly #SmallSteps #YoungInvestor #WealthBuilding #StartNow
